content_zh:
叶梁晨被打了一下，一下子清醒过来，讪讪的一笑：“反正你又不会赢，早拿晚拿有什么关系。”
展步再次问道：“你们还没说，如果我赢了呢？”
杜大叔一笑：“赌码必须要对等，如果你赢的话，自然要赢同样的钱。”
叶梁晨看了看桌子上的钱，再想想比脸都干净的兜，他哪里有那么多钱和展步对赌。
展步一眼就看出叶梁晨的窘状，他冷哼：“没钱？没钱赌什么，想要空手套白狼，我没空和你玩，哪里凉快滚哪里去。”
叶梁晨脖子一红，自己怎么能在杨寓筠面前丢了面子？他吼道：“赌就赌，你要是赢了，我肯定能给你同样的钱，你不就是怕输钱，才挤兑我吗？说的好像你能赢似的。”
展步摇摇头：“钱呢？压上来啊？我可没听说过赌钱可以开空头支票的。”
“你……说到底，你就是怕输，什么相术师，不过是糊弄人的把戏，我就不信，你能接连蒙对好几次！”叶梁晨故意不说钱的事，把矛头引向别的地方。
展步呵呵一笑：“好啊，小爷今天心情好，我要是赢了，我也不要你钱，你就自己扇自己三巴掌，边扇边喊我三声爷爷。怎么样？”
叶梁晨一听不用拿钱，想都不想：“好！”
杜大叔接着问展步：“那小杨要是输了呢？”
展步的眼在杨寓筠的胸脯上瞟了两眼，一副思索的样子。
看到展步的眼神，叶梁晨不干了：“哎，你往哪里看呢？我告诉你不要乱打主意，不要提不切实际的赌注。”
展步本来没想好赢了之后要什么，他只是习惯性的把目光放在自己职业的位置上而已，听到叶梁晨的声音，他故意说道：“如果我赢了，你就让我亲一下好了。”
叶梁晨刚想说话，杨寓筠就伸出一只手：“好，亲一口又不会掉肉，但是如果你输了，不许耍赖！”
叶梁晨此时心中郁闷，杨寓筠可是叶梁晨的梦中情人，平日里杨寓筠虽然对自己不错，但是距离却拿捏的非常巧妙，丝毫不给自己任何亲近的机会，却想不到竟然和展步打这种赌注，这让叶梁晨非常嫉妒。
但是转念一想，反正又不会输，自己乱操心什么。
“铃铃铃……”
就在两人刚刚说完之后，杜鹏程的手机响了。
听到手机铃声，杜鹏程一愣，脸色不好看。

现在自己落魄了，以前那些所谓的朋友，见了自己都躲得远远的，谁会给自己打电话？现在给自己打电话的，不是银行催债的，就是厂里几个小领导诉苦要工资的，现在的杜鹏程，都有些害怕手机响。
不过杜鹏程还是无奈的拿起了手机，动作很慢，看了一眼来电显示是，杜鹏程的脸色一下子变的激动，动作仿佛从一个暮年老牛忽然变成了年轻猎豹一样，一下子接通了电话，放到了耳边。
“林老板，我是杜鹏程。”
“啊？我是去拜访您，可是听您的秘术说，您没在。”
“啊？这是真的吗？真的太感激您了，我都快撑不下去了，要不是您这一个电话，我都打算关门了！”
“您要是这么决定了，那我不止能做到宾阳第一，就算在省里做到前几名都有信心，改天，哦不，今天，我马上去您那里，仔细商谈！”
这个时候，几个人神态怪异，展步的话太准了，这才多久，展步的话立刻应验了！
不用多说，看杜鹏程的神态就知道，杜鹏程是时来运转了。
杜鹏程挂断了电话，这个时候的杜鹏程，脸色不是一般的好，就算是杨寓筠和叶梁晨不懂相术，此时也能感受到杜鹏程那种一飞冲天的气势，一个电话，杜鹏程的气质立刻发生了天翻地覆的变化。
杜鹏程拉着展步的手：“你是我见过的最厉害的相师！你是去宾阳上大学吧？放心，到了宾阳，那就是到家了，以后有什么事，直接给我打电话！不过今天我下了火车只怕就要再回去一趟……”
这个时候，杜鹏程也心态大好，调笑着说道：“嘿嘿，我可是刚才见证了一个赌约的，那谁，不会想要赖账吧？”
听到杜鹏程的话，杨寓筠脸色一红，低下了头不说话。
而叶梁晨更是脸色苍白，他没想到，展步的话这么灵验，自己不仅拿不到钱，还要叫展步爷爷，他可不想出丑，要是在杨寓筠面前出这种丑，以后就不用在她面前抬起头了。

content_en:
Ye Liangchen was beaten and suddenly woke up. He smiled sarcastically: "You won't win anyway, so what does it matter if you take it early or later."
Zhan Bu asked again: "You haven't said yet, what if I win?"
Uncle Du smiled: "The betting numbers must be equal. If you win, you will naturally win the same amount of money."
Ye Liangchen looked at the money on the table, and then thought about Dou, who was cleaner than his face. How could he have so much money to gamble with Zhan Bu.
Zhan Bu could see Ye Liangchen's embarrassment at a glance, and he snorted coldly: "No money? What's the point of gambling if you don't have money? If you want nothing, I don't have time to play with you. You can go wherever you want."
Ye Liangchen's neck turned red. How could he lose face in front of Yang Yujun? He yelled: "Just bet. If you win, I will definitely give you the same money. Aren't you just afraid of losing money, so you are running against me? You say it as if you can win."
Zhan Bu shook his head: "Where's the money? Press it up? I've never heard that gambling can write a bad check."
"You... after all, you are just afraid of losing. What a fortune teller, it's just a trick to fool people. I don't believe that you can be fooled several times in a row!" Ye Liangchen deliberately didn't talk about the money and pointed the finger elsewhere.
Zhan Bu chuckled: "Okay, I'm in a good mood today. If I win, I won't ask for your money. Just slap yourself three times and call me grandpa three times while doing it. How about it?"
When Ye Liangchen heard that there was no need to take money, he said without even thinking: "Okay!"
Uncle Du then asked Zhan Bu: "What if Xiao Yang loses?"
Zhan Bu glanced at Yang Yuyun's chest twice, looking thoughtful.
Seeing Zhan Bu's eyes, Ye Liangchen stopped: "Hey, where are you looking? I tell you not to make random decisions or make unrealistic bets."
Zhan Bu had not thought about what he wanted after winning. He just habitually focused on his professional position. When he heard Ye Liangchen's voice, he deliberately said: "If I win, just let me kiss you."
Just as Ye Liangchen was about to speak, Yang Yuyun stretched out a hand: "Okay, a kiss won't make you lose any flesh, but if you lose, don't cheat!"
Ye Liangchen felt depressed at this time. Yang Yuyun was Ye Liangchen's dream lover. Although Yang Yuyun was nice to him on weekdays, he kept the distance very cleverly and did not give him any chance to get close. However, he did not expect that he would make such a bet with Zhan Bu, which made Ye Liangchen very jealous.
But then I thought about it, I won't lose anyway, so why should I worry about it?
"Ring ring ring..."
Just after the two of them finished talking, Du Pengcheng's cell phone rang.
When he heard the ringtone of his cell phone, Du Pengcheng was stunned and his face looked ugly.
Now that I am down and out, those so-called friends in the past would stay away from me when they saw me. Who would call me? The people calling him now are either bank debt collectors or several small leaders in the factory complaining about their wages. Now Du Pengcheng is a little afraid of his cell phone ringing.
However, Du Pengcheng still reluctantly picked up the phone, moving very slowly. After looking at the caller ID, Du Pengcheng's face suddenly became excited, and his movements seemed to change from an old cow to a young cheetah. He suddenly connected the phone and put it to his ear.
"Boss Lin, I am Du Pengcheng."
"Ah? I went to visit you, but according to your secret technique, you were not there."
"Ah? Is this true? I'm so grateful to you. I can hardly stand it anymore. If it weren't for your call, I would have closed the door!"
"If you decide like this, then I will not only be number one in Binyang, but I will also be confident that I will be among the top in the province. Another day, oh no, today, I will go to your place right away to discuss it carefully!"
At this time, several people looked weird, and Zhan Bu's words were too accurate. After just a short time, Zhan Bu's words came true immediately!
Needless to say, just look at Du Pengcheng’s demeanor and you will know that Du Pengcheng isThings have turned around.
Du Pengcheng hung up the phone. At this time, Du Pengcheng's face was not generally good. Even if Yang Yuyun and Ye Liangchen didn't understand physiognomy, they could still feel Du Pengcheng's soaring momentum. With a phone call, Du Pengcheng's temperament immediately changed drastically.
Du Pengcheng took Zhan Bu's hand: "You are the most powerful fortune teller I have ever seen! Are you going to Binyang to go to college? Don't worry, when you get to Binyang, you're home. If you need anything in the future, just call me! But today I'm afraid I have to go back again after I get off the train..."
At this time, Du Pengcheng was also in a good mood, and said with a smile: "Hey, I just witnessed a bet, so who wouldn't want to default on it?"
Hearing Du Pengcheng's words, Yang Yuyun's face turned red and he lowered his head and said nothing.
And Ye Liangchen was even more pale. He didn't expect that Zhan Bu's words would be so effective. Not only would he not get the money, but he would also have to call Zhan Bu Grandpa. He didn't want to make a fool of himself. If he made such a fool of himself in front of Yang Yujun, he wouldn't have to raise his head in front of her in the future.
